authority: the GitHub-answer memos of the prr-shadow seams (BH-10351)
note: state/prr-memo/scheduler-parents.tsv: the scheduler seam's stack-parent answer (bin/lib/prr-shadow.d/scheduler.sh), rows <owner/repo> TAB <branch> TAB <fingerprint> TAB <answer>, for a parent branch with no open PR: GitHub's `none`, `merged <n> <url>` or `closed <n> <url>`. The fingerprint is the PR record's closed and merged rows of the branch (/api/pr-record-refs); a row is served only while the record's open list has no PR of the branch and the fingerprint is unchanged, so it never ages out on a clock. Written tmp+mv only in step record after a GitHub read that answered; a failed read writes nothing. Retention: each scheduler tick keeps only the rows of that tick's parent branches (sched_parent_memo_gc). Losing the file costs one GitHub read per parent branch. Machine-local, never carried
